description.value: Crooked Horn Farm is a certified organic vegetable farm in the Slocan Valley near Winlaw, BC, run by Gord and Ange. The farm offers seasonal CSA shares with weekly pickup options in the Slocan Valley and Nelson, providing fresh locally grown produce from late spring through fall. A touring cyclist riding through the rural Slocan corridor could find fresh organic vegetables here during the growing season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Facebook page fetched successfully and confirms the OSM address (5361 Filipoff Rd, V0G 2J0), phone ((250) 226-7062), and email (info@crookedhornfarm.ca). The page describes a certified organic veggie farm in the Slocan Valley offering CSA shares; the most recent post is April 2023, now over three years old, which raises a mild currency concern. The Facebook About section reveals a separate business website (crookedhornfarm.ca) that OSM does not list as the primary URL. No evidence for bike parking, water, or most amenity fields was present in the fetched content.
concerns: OSM lists the Facebook page (https://www.facebook.com/crookedhornfarm) as the website, but the Facebook About section reveals a separate business website (http://crookedhornfarm.ca/) — updated to use the direct website URL.
Most recent Facebook post is from April 2023, over three years ago as of June 2026; unclear whether the farm is still actively selling or the social media presence has simply lapsed.
Farm appears seasonal (late-May to October CSA); may not be accessible or selling produce outside of growing season.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, operational certified organic farm in a rural cycling corridor; useful to touring cyclists seeking fresh local produce during the growing season.
